name: sdio_host_regs
desc: SD / SDIO host: command, argument, responses, status, clock and bus control, block size, timeout, interrupt enables.

registers.name: CMD
registers.desc: a write starts the command; reads back the last one

fields.name: RESP
fields.desc: response: 0 none, 1 short 48 bit, 2 long 136 bit

fields.name: DIR
fields.desc: data: 0 none, 1 read block, 2 write block

fields.name: NO_CRC
fields.desc: 1: no CRC7 check of the response (R3 / R7)

registers.name: RESP
registers.desc: response: short in RESP[0], long 127..0 in RESP[3]..RESP[0]

fields.name: DAT_CRC_ERR
fields.desc: data CRC16, end bit or CRC status error

fields.name: BUF_ERR
fields.desc: bad BLKSIZE, write without a full buffer, or command while busy

fields.name: HALF_PERIOD
fields.desc: SD clock half period in system clocks (minimum 1)

registers.name: TIMEOUT
registers.desc: data / busy timeout in SD clocks

registers.name: IRQ_EN
registers.desc: bit n enables STATUS bit n + 1 for irq_o
